note: Episode 06 lines in the brief's mandatory order. src = [transcript entry, first word, last word]. Transcript fixes (Whisper mishearings, timings kept): "10th"→"tenth", "VEDA"→"beta", "ReviewCount"→"review count" (split at its midpoint).

lines.text: My competitor has a hundred Google reviews... and I have five!
lines.why: the conflict, then the shock lands

lines.text: That's it. My business is officially dead!
lines.why: the studio turns into a tiny funeral; tears start

lines.text: Goodbye, little roofing company. You deserved better.
lines.why: flowers placed on 'better'; ~0.9 s still + violin; the assistant enters quietly, notices, 0.5 s pause

lines.text: Are you holding a funeral for your Google Business Profile?
More reviews can help. They don't automatically win every search.
Wait... reviews aren't the whole ranking?
Google also considers relevance, distance, and prominence.
lines.why: the memorial becomes a local-search map; three factor cards

lines.text: Reviews and ratings matter, but review count alone doesn't decide Google Maps rankings.
Keep your business information accurate, choose relevant categories, and ask genuine customers for honest feedback.
So... I still have a chance?
Maybe focus on customers instead of planning a burial.
So... should I take the flowers back?
Keep the flowers. Your office looks depressing.
lines.why: flowers become office decor; pause after the punchline

lines.text: Oh, and here's some quick SEO news!
On November tenth, OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT in beta!
Eligible businesses can claim their profiles through Business Hub and, after verification, update their information!
